meta.title: Model Quota
meta.description: Shows the remaining balance or the Coding Plan 5-hour / weekly quota for the active model provider below the input box.

messages.title: Model Quota
messages.historyWheelHint: Scroll up for a shorter range, down for a longer range
messages.missingCloudflareCredential: Cloudflare API token or account ID not configured
messages.settingsHint: Configure caching, history collection, and custom providers. Changes apply immediately after saving.
messages.settingsNotFound: The model quota settings namespace was not found. Disable and re-enable Model Quota on the Plugins page. If it is still unavailable, restart dsh.
messages.settingsReadOnly: The current configuration is read-only and cannot be changed here.
messages.settingsNoChanges: There are no changes to save.
messages.settingsConflict: Settings changed in another page. The latest values have been loaded; review them before saving again.
messages.cacheSecondsHint: Defaults to 30 seconds; 0 disables the successful-response cache. Leave blank to restore the default.
messages.cacheSecondsInvalid: Cache TTL must be a finite number greater than or equal to 0.
messages.historyEnabledHint: Enabled by default; records quota changes in the background and stores them in local SQLite.
messages.historyDefaultRangeHint: Defaults to the last 1 hour. Reopened history popups use the saved range.
messages.historyDefaultRangeInvalid: The default history chart range is invalid.
messages.historyIntervalSecondsHint: Defaults to 30 seconds, with a minimum of 1. Leave blank to restore the default.
messages.historyIntervalInvalid: Collection interval must be a finite number greater than or equal to 1.
messages.providersConfigHint: Configure overrides by provider ID; every field is preserved. Leave blank to restore {}.
messages.providersInvalid: Providers must be an object, every provider entry must be an object, and IDs cannot be empty.
messages.credentialsHint: Some providers need an extra console credential, beyond the inference key, to read quota. Values are stored in the Host credential store and never returned to the browser.
messages.credentialsEffective: Changes take effect on the next quota refresh (up to 60 seconds).
messages.mimoCookieHint: Used by the xiaomi and xiaomi-token-plan providers. Sign in to platform.xiaomimimo.com, copy the full Cookie header from any /api/v1/ request, and keep at least serviceToken and userId.
messages.qwenTokenHint: Used by qwen-token-plan providers. Run bl auth login --console and copy access_token from ~/.bailian/config.json.
messages.xaiKeyHint: Used for the xai provider quota. Inference API keys cannot read billing; create a read-only, team-scoped key under console.x.ai → Settings → Management Keys.
messages.adminKeyHint: Used for the anthropic and openai month-to-date usage. Plain inference keys cannot read usage: create sk-ant-admin… under Console → Settings → Admin Keys (Anthropic) or sk-admin… under platform.openai.com → Admin keys (OpenAI, organization owner only).
messages.githubTokenHint: Used for the github-copilot premium request quota. Any GitHub token works (ghp_ / gho_ / fine-grained with Plan: read).
messages.codexTokenHint: Used for the openai-codex 5-hour / weekly windows. Provide a ChatGPT OAuth access token (for example from the Codex CLI login); the endpoint is unofficial and may change.
messages.codexAccountHint: The ChatGPT-Account-Id header value used together with the token above.
messages.cloudflareTokenHint: Used for the cloudflare balance / spend query. Needs an account-level API token (AI Gateway Read / Billing Read); keep it separate from the inference token.
messages.cloudflareAccountHint: The account ID the cloudflare query targets; shown in the Cloudflare Dashboard sidebar.
messages.credentialReadOnly: This credential comes from the current configuration layer and cannot be changed here.
messages.credentialSaved: Saved. It takes effect on the next quota refresh.
